scope: GraphQL ASCII name classification in Cloudflare generated JS
Cloudflare/AWS response-only boolean prefix lookup, shared in generator
Cloudflare unchanged canonical path fast return
excluded: AWS request canonicalization (would reduce accepted 10KiB policy capacity)
dependencies, public API and CI configuration changes

method.native: Local HTTP client -> native workerd -> separate loopback origin, 1000 warmup and 1000 samples/process, 2 processes/variant. Pooled p50/p95 and per-process data; cold first request retained separately. Combined implementation of all 3 optimizations, not isolated effects.
method.node: Generated minified CloudFront response handler in Node 24, 1000 warmup and 5000 calls x 5 batches x 2 processes/variant. All 3 workloads validate Cache-Control and Vary.
method.policy: 64 auth prefixes, max_uri_length=8192 for native deep paths; GraphQL max_fields=50000,max_body_bytes=1048576; native has no origin HMAC/body hashing. Raw application/graphql queries exactly 2/32/64KiB.
limits: Loopback wall time includes client/origin/scheduling; neither deployed CDN CPU time nor real-user network latency. AWS timings are Node measurements.
Short/private and normalization-required controls show regressions/noise; no general non-regression or universal speedup claim.
Cold first-request data are sparse and startup/JIT effects vary; no cold-start improvement claim.
AWS response B2 deep-path batch means range 0.0181 to 0.0489ms; native run ranges retained.
The 2KiB case also uses the same max_fields=50000 policy; the preceding audit used default max_fields=200 separately, but those old measurements are not current implementation evidence.
